name: Keg rack
description: Two oak kegs lying side by side on a heavy timber cradle, about 1.45 × 0.6 × 1 m: each keg of curved staves held by four iron hoops, a wooden spigot in its front head; the cradle of sills, posts and top rails with angled chocks under the kegs.

provenance.prompt: Two kegs on a timber cradle, about 1.5 × 0.6 × 1 m.
